people.name: Ephai
people.line: A Netophathite whose son joined Gedaliah.

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

people.name: Jezaniah
people.line: A leader of the Judean forces

people.name: Johanan
people.line: A Judean military leader after the fall of Jerusalem

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Son of Kareah, came to Gedaliah at Mizpah

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Netophah
people.line: A town in Judah, home to several notable individuals

people.name: Seraiah
people.line: Officer under Gedaliah, son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite

people.name: Tanhumeth
people.line: Supporter of Gedaliah after Jerusalem's fall

translations.web: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.
translations.bsb: they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah—Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maacathite—they and their men.
translations.kjv: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
translations.asv: then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, to wit, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
